query_text: Given a <span> in HTML I want to change its color on mouse over.

parts.text: The best and most efficient way to change the color of a `` on mouseover is using **CSS**. Here are the three ways to achieve this, starting with the most recommended approach. --- ### Method 1: Using CSS (Recommended) This is the cleanest and most standard way to do it. You define the default style for your span and use the `:hover` pseudo-class to change the color when the mouse moves over it. **HTML:** ```html Hover over me! ``` **CSS:** ```css .hover-text { color: black; /* Default color */ transition: color 0.3s ease; /* Optional: Adds a smooth transition effect */ } .hover-text:hover { color: #ff4757; /* Color when hovered (e.g., coral red) */ } ``` --- ### Method 2: Inline HTML & CSS (Quickest) If you are working on a simple project and cannot access an external stylesheet, you can use inline Javascript event listeners (`onmouseover` and `onmouseout`). **HTML:** ```html Hover over me! ``` --- ### Method 3: Using JavaScript (For Dynamic Elements) If you need to handle this dynamically in JavaScript (for example, if you are adding elements via script), you can use event listeners. **HTML:** ```html Hover over me! ``` **JavaScript:** ```javascript const span = document.getElementById('my-span'); // Change color on mouse enter span.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { span.style.color = 'blue'; }); // Revert color on mouse leave span.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { span.style.color = 'black'; }); ``` ### Which one should you use? * Use **Method 1 (CSS)** for 99% of use cases because it is highly performant and separates your styling from your HTML logic. * Use **Method 2** only if you need a quick "one-off" test.
